purpose: Teach: 温室/鶏肉/ダイニング/ガレージ/ライブラリー/エレクトロニクス/モノクロ/矢印

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが温室でトマトを育てられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, your father grew tomatoes in the greenhouse.
lines.style: Gentle, reaching backward through time. Soft attack on the opening. Even pace, quiet warmth. The tone of someone sharing something precious he hasn't said aloud in years.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、鶏肉のお料理が得意だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — your grandfather was quite good with cooking chicken, wasn't he?
lines.style: Warm, slightly distant. A gentle correction wrapped in affection. She's following her own thread, not quite on his. Soft, conversational, the patience of long marriage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家のダイニングを改装されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, your father renovated the dining room at home.
lines.style: Continuing the thread of memory. Same gentle weight as before. Speaking as if these facts live in him, solid and certain. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ガレージで車を整備されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather maintained the car in the garage, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Persistent, affectionate, still on her own path. Not quite matching his rhythm but holding his hand anyway. A small smile in the voice—she knows what she's doing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ばあさんが地域ライブラリーを設立されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, you founded the community library.
lines.style: Voice lifts slightly—pride and tenderness both present. Still measured, still reaching back. The moment of saying something he's proud of her for, quietly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、エレクトロニクスのお仕事を長くされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather worked in electronics for so many years, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: She's fully in her own conversation now, warm and certain. Not correcting—honoring. The kind of gentle insistence that comes from decades of knowing someone. A touch of mischief underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんとモノクロ写真館で撮ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, we took pictures together at the black-and-white photo studio with your father.
lines.style: A shift—more specific, more tender. The memory is visual now, not just factual. Slower pace. The vulnerability of 'we took pictures together.' Trailing into quietness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、矢印標識のない時代を懐かしまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to miss those days without the arrow signs, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Quiet, almost to herself. She's drifting now, or perhaps knowing exactly where she is. Affectionate, slightly playful, the intimacy of shared time and fading edges. Closes gently.
